lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Want to go to the seaside this weekend?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 好啊！天气预报说周末晴天。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Tiānqì yùbào shuō zhōumò qíngtiān.
lines.english: Great! Weather forecast says weekend will be sunny.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 开车去吧。两个小时就到。
lines.pinyin: Kāichē qù ba. Liǎng gè xiǎoshí jiù dào.
lines.english: Drive there. Two hours to arrive.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 泳衣、防晒霜、帽子、太阳镜。还有吃的。
lines.pinyin: Yǒngyī, fángshàishuāng, màozi, tàiyángjìng. Hái yǒu chī de.
lines.english: Swimsuit, sunscreen, hat, sunglasses. And food.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What can we do at the seaside?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 游泳、晒太阳、捡贝壳、拍照。晚上吃海鲜。
lines.pinyin: Yóuyǒng, shài tàiyáng, jiǎn bèiké, pāizhào. Wǎnshang chī hǎixiān.
lines.english: Swim, sunbathe, collect shells, take photos. Eat seafood at night.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 听起来很有趣！那周末见。
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlai hěn yǒuqù! Nà zhōumò jiàn.
